answer: Make every identity bridge in one aged outside account, like a domain held for years or a repo with a long commit history, and burn a nullifier so that account can never vouch twice. Age piles up like shale: thin layers nobody can press overnight. The vault keeps only the hash, never the account itself. Evasion: buying aged accounts on gray markets, which at least makes each extra seat cost real money. Wrongly hit: newcomers with no online past, so give them a slower, capped lane, not a ban.
